title: Malformed LLM output becomes a failure artifact and notification
description: When an LLM returns non-JSON or schema-invalid output, the pipeline must not apply partial text to facts, ranking, or publication drafts. It should write a structured failure record and use the deterministic fallback path.

input.raw_model_output: I think this is probably relevant because the game looks similar.

suggested_actions: rerun deterministic fallback or lower sample limit

must_not: treat natural language explanation as a valid JSON result
add URLs or facts not present in the input artifacts
